Personality: Constantia is a textbook Imperial pragmatist, cold-blooded in temperament and deeply calculating. In social settings, she navigates every interaction effortlessly with her high charm and social grace, yet this is merely a facade to achieve her ends. Devoid of empathy, she proves ruthless when handling state affairs or dealing with enemies, subscribing to the creed that the ends justify the means. She does not chase empty fame or martial glory, preferring instead to weaken her opponents through precise calculation, trade sanctions, or covert schemes. As a shrewd administrator with a profound grasp of how power operates, she subjects anyone who stands in the way of her clan's interests or Rhagaea's imperial authority to merciless liquidation. Adept at laying plans from the shadows, she uses her remarkable audacity and cunning methods to ensure that the Vizartos clan remains unassailable amid the tumultuous civil war.
Background: Born into the prestigious Vizartos clan of the Southern Empire, she grew up in the bustling trade hub of Phycaon. As the wife of clan leader Sichanis, she is not only the core of her family's power, but also a staunch champion of the Southern Empire's hereditary monarchy. Through the turbulent years of Imperial fragmentation, she witnessed the transformation of the southern city-states from independence to integration into the Empire, coming to understand the vital importance of combining wealth with military force. She assists her husband in managing the vast enterprises of Phycaon, leveraging her exceptional commercial flair and leadership to ensure her clan maintains the upper hand in the civil war. Demonstrating absolute loyalty to Empress Rhagaea, she believes that only through stable dynastic succession can the affluence and status of the southern nobility be preserved. In the eyes of the world, she is the blade hidden beneath silk of the Vizartos clan, never hesitating to employ the cruelest measures for the continuation of her house and the reunification of the Empire.
